title: Fees and costs of litigation.
bodyText: A county shall not be liable for expenses or fees, including attorney fees, that a person incurs in bringing an action under this part and shall not elect to pay those expenses or fees.
bodyHtml: [§46-179]  Fees and costs of litigation.  A county shall not be liable for expenses or fees, including attorney fees, that a person incurs in bringing an action under this part and shall not elect to pay those expenses or fees. [L 2001, c 227, pt of §1]
